messages:
natalie: Quick question — we're finalizing the routing/quotas design for API keys. Do we want routing policy to prefer project-scoped keys for latency/cost routing and fall back to org keys when project capacity is exhausted?

diego: leaning yes. project keys give us stronger per-project quota control + telemetry. fallback to org key makes sense for reliability but we need to ensure quota accounting isn't double-counted.

priya: agree but UX concern: console needs to make the fallback visible to end users. otherwise product teams will be surprised by cost/latency shifts. Can we add a small banner and per-route telemetry that shows "served-by" (project/org/standby-model)?

sam: implementation nit: routing currently matches by key -> project -> preferred-pool. If pool full we do model-variant fallback. To add org fallback we'd need to change the matching to: key -> project pools -> if no capacity then check org pools -> then cross-org fallback (if allowed). That opens up auth/consent questions for org-level keys.

natalie: consent question = important. Org keys can imply cross-project billing. We should require an explicit toggle on the org key to allow "serve-for-projects". Default = off. Console toggle with audit log.

priya: +1 for toggle. Also add telemetry tag so billing shows which key served each request. That helps debug regressions where a project claims high latency but actually got served by org pool.

sam: on quotas: do we treat org fallback consumption against project quota or org quota? My vote: if served by org pool, count against org quota. Else project quota if served by project pool. If we want true "charge back" to project while using org capacity that's a more complex accounting path.

aisha: product POV — customers expect isolation. If org admins turn on fallback, they should know traffic might be billed to org. We should document both modes: "isolation-first" (project quota enforced, deny if exhausted) and "reliable-fallback" (use org capacity, bill org).

diego: sounds good. For the API surface: keep the existing API key header the same but add a query param/metadata field to opt into fallback behavior for a specific request: e.g., X-Redwood-Fallback: project-only|org-allowed. Default = org-allowed if org toggle enabled.

priya: careful: not all SDKs will set header. Console toggle + org policy should override. But allow per-request override for advanced users. Also we need a way for customers to opt into per-request billing attribution so they can pin costs to a sub-team.

infra-bot: deploy queued: feature/route-fallback-v2 -> staging (sha: b7c9f4). Tests: unit 128/130, e2e flaky on quota edge-case.

sam: noted infra-bot — the e2e flaky is the accounting path for fallback serving. I'll triage tomorrow. For now, should we block rollout to prod?

natalie: block until e2e fixes the accounting if rollout enables org fallback by default. If it's behind a feature flag defaulting to safe behavior (isolation-first) we can roll.

diego: deployment plan: feature flag default = isolation-first, console toggle to enable org-fallback per-org, and a separate admin override for per-request header. We'll ship telemetry and billing attribution in the same release to avoid surprises.

priya: UX tasks: banner in project settings, new row in quota table showing fallback events, and a modal explaining billing implications. I'll write the copy.

aisha: legal/compliance check: org fallback could cross data residency if pools are regional. We must ensure pool selection respects region affinity/policy. Add to backlog item for routing constraints.

sam: implementation checklist I sketched: 1) routing match order change (feature-flagged) 2) quota accounting hook that tags consumption entity 3) billing attribution event in ingestion pipeline 4) console toggle + telemetry UI 5) audits + logs. I'll paste code snippet after triage.

natalie: thanks all. Quick follow-ups: sam — paste the checklist as a PR description. priya — add wireframes to the ticket. diego — coordinate rollout schedule with infra. I'll sync with legal about residency.

priya: wireframes uploaded to the ticket.

sam: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/route-fallback/pulls/92 (WIP) — includes feature flag and unit tests.

infra-bot: reminder: e2e job rerun scheduled in 30m.

natalie: awesome. let's reconvene after e2e passes and we have billing event shape agreed. :thumbsup:
